grammar.explanation: 当组长/当队长 uses 当 as act as or serve as. 今天我当组长 describes a role; 我当过组长 adds experience, and 当时 gives a time in another construction. Do not infer willingness from a name on a list. Ask 可以吗 before assigning a role. Hosting is a responsibility, not a claim of higher ability.

examples.zh: 今天我当组长，你当队长。
examples.py: jīn tiān wǒ dāng zǔ zhǎng , nǐ dāng duì zhǎng .
examples.en: Today I act as group leader and you as captain.

examples.py: nǐ yuàn yì dāng fù zé rén ma ?
examples.en: Would you like to be the person responsible?

examples.zh: 我可以当组长，但先说明规则。
examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ dāng zǔ zhǎng , dàn xiān shuō míng guī zé .
examples.en: I can act as leader, but first explain the rules.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我举手了，所以你一定当队长。
commonMistakes.why: One person raising a hand does not assign another person a role.

grammar.purpose: Read an action together with its object or purpose
grammar.explanation: 办活动、举行活动、进行练习、参加球队 and 举手问问题 are action phrases. A phrase identifies an action but does not by itself say it is finished: 想办活动 is an intention. Keep verbs with appropriate objects; 举行 is used for an event, not a ball as an object. In 举手问问题 the first action enables the second. Distinguish the role 当组长 from the activity 办活动.

examples.zh: 我们想办活动，还没有举行。
examples.py: wǒ men xiǎng bàn huó dòng , hái méi yǒu jǔ xíng .
examples.en: We want to organize an event; it has not been held yet.

examples.py: dà jiā jǔ shǒu wèn wèn tí .
examples.en: Everyone raises a hand to ask questions.

examples.zh: 队长先说明规则，再进行练习。
examples.py: duì zhǎng xiān shuō míng guī zé , zài jìn xíng liàn xí .
examples.en: The captain first explains the rules, then carries out practice.

commonMistakes.why: 举行 takes an event; 篮球 alone names the sport or ball rather than the event.

lines.zh: 星期六想办活动，谁来当组长？
lines.py: xīng qī liù xiǎng bàn huó dòng , shéi lái dāng zǔ zhǎng ?
lines.en: We want to organize an event on Saturday. Who will lead?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我可以当，但先说活动的目的吧。
lines.py: wǒ kě yǐ dāng , dàn xiān shuō huó dòng de mù dì ba .
lines.en: I can, but first tell me the purpose.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 让大家说汉语，也一起运动。
lines.py: ràng dà jiā shuō hàn yǔ , yě yì qǐ yùn dòng .
lines.en: To let everyone speak Mandarin and exercise together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 名称就叫朋友见面，行吗？
lines.py: míng chēng jiù jiào péng you jiàn miàn , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Can we call it Friends Meet?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。报名以后一定要打篮球吗？
lines.py: xíng . bào míng yǐ hòu yí dìng yào dǎ lán qiú ma ?
lines.en: Fine. Does signing up mean we must play basketball?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用，想参加哪队就先问。网球、排球都还没有确认。
lines.py: bù yòng , xiǎng cān jiā nǎ duì jiù xiān wèn . wǎng qiú , pái qiú dōu hái méi yǒu què rèn .
lines.en: No. Ask about the team you want to join; tennis and volleyball are not confirmed yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 名单上五个人，能组成两队吗？
lines.py: míng dān shàng wǔ gè rén , néng zǔ chéng liǎng duì ma ?
lines.en: There are five on the list. Can we form two teams?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先别分。今天每队三个人，人数还不够。
lines.py: xiān bié fēn . jīn tiān měi duì sān gè rén , rén shù hái bù gòu .
lines.en: Not yet. Today each team needs three; there are not enough people yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 体育场下雨就不能用了吧？
lines.py: tǐ yù chǎng xià yǔ jiù bù néng yòng le ba ?
lines.en: We cannot use the sports ground in rain, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就问体育馆有没有开，别先说一定能用。
lines.py: nà jiù wèn tǐ yù guǎn yǒu méi yǒu kāi , bié xiān shuō yí dìng néng yòng .
lines.en: Then ask whether the sports hall is open; do not say it is definitely available first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我刚举手，是想问规则，不是报名当队长。
lines.py: wǒ gāng jǔ shǒu , shì xiǎng wèn guī zé , bù shì bào míng dāng duì zhǎng .
lines.en: I raised my hand to ask the rules, not to volunteer as captain.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。谁愿意当队长，我们再问。
lines.py: zhī dào le . shéi yuàn yì dāng duì zhǎng , wǒ men zài wèn .
lines.en: Understood. We will ask who wants to be captain.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A volunteer leader and a purpose, with details still to confirm
Five people already form two teams of three
